text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
My heart is still pounding... I won... I 
really won!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It really feels amazing after all! It's so 
refreshing, and the crowd got so hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“—Wait... Does that mean so many people 
were watching me...?”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I hope I didn't look like I was 
getting cocky... Like smirking before even 
crossing the finish line...
choice_data_list: You ran strong all the way to the finish!
Let's go for the win next time too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Was it really alright? I'm kind of 
worried... My mind was a total blank the 
entire run, so winning like that feels...
choice_data_list:
Let's stack up wins one by one and become 
'great'!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. This single victory, for the 
sake of the future..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll keep doing my best from now on too, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next’... You're right. Today was just 
one step toward becoming a great 
Umamusume. I can't let my guard down 
yet..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Let's review the race together. We have to 
make the most of it for our training...!
